selection_rule.frozen_values_source: human review of the completed dual-population discovery diagnostics
selection_rule.no_reselection_rule: neither model nor top_n may be changed after any seed 1296..1315 outcome is observed
selection_rule.interpretation: pre-specified intervention doses for out-of-seed replication, not estimates of a unique number of functional heads

discovery_source.prior_seed_scope_note: 1295 is a conservative upper bound covering every prior V4.4 correct-intervention supplement, not only the ablation discovery prefix

confirmation_design.shared_run_rule: all-example and clean-correct analyses are derived from the same intervention rows; clean-correct is the exact baseline-correct and format-valid subset
confirmation_design.uncertainty: nonparametric seed-cluster bootstrap 95% CI with 10000 deterministic draws
confirmation_design.companion_test: two-sided seed-cluster sign-flip test for registered accuracy, absolute-error, and prediction-change endpoints
confirmation_design.multiplicity_note: four model-by-dose families are reported individually; any joint confirmatory claim must account for these four frozen comparisons

freeze_rationale.2: discovery candidate for the all-example absolute-shift endpoint
freeze_rationale.4: discovery candidate for the clean-correct failure endpoint

freeze_rationale.1: strongest discovery candidate for both registered populations
freeze_rationale.2: pre-specified adjacent dose requested before seed extrapolation
